rule: Trending day = weighted RPI > 100 (mean of 2-week, 3-month and 6-month performance vs the market index x 100), EMA 9 > EMA 21, a Stage 2 uptrend (above a rising 150-day average) and within 25% of the 52-week high. Pulse = share of a group's liquid stocks' days that were trending over the last 1 week / 1 month / 1 quarter. Groups with 3+ liquid stocks.
backtest: NSE 2017-26: the 10% of groups with the highest 1-month Pulse beat the lowest 10% by +2.9% over the next 3 months (+2.2% in 2017-21, +3.6% in 2022-26), better than plain group return (+1.8%); 1-week Pulse +1.2% over the next month. Trending stocks in top-Pulse groups beat the average stock by +1.4% over 3 months. As a hard filter on ATH breakouts it did not raise returns - use it as a tiebreaker / tailwind. US and ASX: not separately tested.
